motivating_result.posthoc_status: Both horns_left and fern target results have already been inspected repeatedly. This is a final registered posthoc mechanism diagnostic, not independent target-blind validation.

purpose: Test whether a semantic compatibility fitted only from raw signed scribbles can suppress confident but irrelevant SAM completion while retaining the parameter-free soft completion recall benefit.

fixed_phase1_inputs.allowed_phase1_tensor: aggregate_probability q equal to the arithmetic mean of the same ten frozen official SAM3 binary masks

raw_semantic_compatibility.relation: the same query-independent C-RADIO DINO signed multiplicative hash256
raw_semantic_compatibility.classifier: balanced LogisticRegression C=0.01 on raw signed-nonzero capability rows, sample weighted only by raw_reference_weight
raw_semantic_compatibility.compatibility: P_raw=predict_proba(raw scribble positive)^(1/4), the existing regularizer_bandwidth=4 rule

soft_completion.soft_positive_observation: s(q)=q*c(q), computed float64 then frozen float32
scribble_pixel_order: overwrite raw positive pixels to exactly 1
overwrite raw negative pixels to exactly 0

fixed_support.initial_anchor_order: set raw-positive-exclusive primitive rows to 1 and raw-negative-exclusive rows to 0 after forming semantic_completed_initial_unary
fixed_support.feature_similarity: same normalized hash256 RBF with feature_bandwidth=2 and positive reference mask semantic_completed_initial_unary>0
fixed_support.query_edge_gate: sqrt(P_raw_i*P_raw_j), with the same frozen P_raw and no completed-evidence refit
fixed_support.final_anchor_order: after diffusion set raw-positive-exclusive primitive rows to 1 and raw-negative-exclusive rows to 0 again

authority_boundary.source_reference_rgb: already consumed only by the frozen phase1 artifact

execution_order.phase_prelabel: Implement and test the fixed operator, then freeze and reload horns_left and fern selectors. Neither target scorer may start until both selector receipts exist and pass hash validation.
execution_order.phase_score: After the cross-scene hard boundary, score horns_left then fern with the unchanged exact target readout.

gate.pass: follow-up macro improves by at least 0.03, at least one sentinel improves, and neither sentinel regresses by more than 0.03

runtime.thermal_policy: 300W physical limit, launch 79C, soft pause 82C, resume 78C, hard abort 85C, no peer-GPU coupling
